verdict.rationale: Steel documents dedicated integrations for OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini Computer Use that run vision-based agent loops (operating on screenshots) atop a Steel browser session, directly enabling a vision/computer-use mode alongside its DOM-based Sessions API and CLI actions. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of vision mode working on canvas-heavy UIs, and detail on switching seamlessly between DOM and vision modes within one session.
